description: This file defines the ProxyBuilder class responsible for generating proxy class code for Drupal services, including class name, namespace, methods, and lazy loading logic.

classes.name: ProxyBuilder
classes.description: A class that generates proxy class code for Drupal services, including methods for building class names, namespaces, and method bodies.

methods.name: buildProxyClassName
methods.description: Generates the proxy class name from a given service class name.

methods.name: buildProxyNamespace
methods.description: Generates the proxy namespace from a given service class name.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the full proxy class code as a string for a given service class.

methods.name: buildLazyLoadItselfMethod
methods.description: Generates the method code for lazy loading the actual service.

methods.name: buildMethod
methods.description: Generates code for a method, including signature and body, based on reflection.

methods.name: buildParameter
methods.description: Generates code for a method parameter based on reflection.

methods.name: buildMethodBody
methods.description: Generates the body of a method that calls the real service.

methods.name: buildConstructorMethod
methods.description: Generates the constructor code for the proxy class.

methods.name: buildUseStatements
methods.description: Generates the use statements for the proxy class (empty in this implementation).
